listenings.text: Morning, everyone. It's Dana. I know you're all waiting, so here are the names. The interschool squad is Kai, Harper, Jess and Renato. Our reserve is Tom. Well done, all of you, and thank you to everybody who surfed on Saturday. It was a really hard choice. Now, the important stuff. The kit arrives on Wednesday. Every surfer gets a hoodie, a yellow jersey and a sticker for the board. The hoodies all look the same, so write your name on the label the same day. The jerseys are not yours to keep. They're the club's, and they come back to me after every comp. First training is Thursday at six. Don't be late. See you there.

Hey mate, it's Kai. Quick question. Did you take a hoodie home from the van yesterday? Because I've got one here, and it isn't mine. Mine has a little hole in the sleeve, and this one doesn't. There's no name on the label, of course. I think it's yours, because it smells like your wax. Coconut, right? So I think you've got mine, and I've got yours. Can you bring it to training on Thursday? Oh, and Jess says the pink towel in the van is hers, not Harper's. Harper says it's hers. I'm staying out of that one. See you Thursday.

reading.rtitle: Squad News: The Names Are Out
paras: On Monday morning, Coach Dana Reid posted the names on the club group. The interschool squad is Kai, Harper, Jess and Renato, and the reserve is Tom. Ollie is still injured, so this year the trophy isn't his to win. "Next year it's mine," he says. The first interschool round is in three weeks.

Every surfer in the squad gets the club kit: a black hoodie with the club logo, a yellow jersey and a sticker for the board. The hoodies are all the same size and color, so Dana has one rule: write your name on the label. "If a hoodie has no name," she says, "it isn't yours. It's the club's."

The rule came one day too late. On Wednesday, Jess wore a hoodie to school, but it wasn't hers. It was Harper's. And Renato took Kai's home by mistake. "Mine is the one with the hole in the sleeve!" Kai said. Now they swap them back every morning in the parking lot.

On Saturdays the squad travels in the club van, with the boards on the roof. The van belongs to the club, not to Dana, so please keep it clean. Anything left in the van goes to the lost property box at school. Right now there are two towels, a leash and one wetsuit in the box. Are they yours? Come and get them.
